# Google Ads for Window Companies

For most window companies, a lead isn’t the finish line. An appointment is set, a rep drives out, the homeowners are (or aren’t) both home, and a sale does or doesn’t happen. Google Ads that optimize for raw leads tend to fill the calendar with appointments that don’t sit or don’t close. Netembark builds Google Ads campaigns for window companies that bid toward appointments held and windows sold, and keep Microsoft, window-tint, and window-cleaning searches out of your campaigns.

[Book a call](https://cal.com/gary-pyatigorsky-netembark/30min)[See case studies](https://www.netembark.com/ppc/home-improvement/window-companies/#results)

Window companies

## How do window companies get better appointments from Google Ads?

**Optimize toward appointments that are held and sold, not form fills, and qualify before the rep drives out.**

*   **Qualify on the form or call:** number of windows, own or rent, timeline, and whether all decision-makers can attend.
*   **Confirm fast:** a quick confirmation call or text cuts no-shows. (Follow applicable consent rules for texting; check with counsel.)
*   **Feed outcomes back:** when Google knows which clicks led to held and sold appointments, bidding shifts toward those searches, times, and areas.
*   **Report the full funnel:** cost per lead, per appointment set, per appointment held, and per sale, by campaign.

[Book a call](https://cal.com/gary-pyatigorsky-netembark/30min)

![Netembark strategists planning a home improvement Google Ads campaign](https://www.netembark.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/ppc-campaign-strategy-1.webp)

Window companies

## Which window searches deserve their own campaigns?

**Whole-house replacement, specific window types and materials, and repair behave differently. Give each its own campaign or ad group and landing page.**

| Theme | Example searches (illustrative, not volume data) | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Replacement (core) | “window replacement near me,” “replacement windows near me,” “window installation company” | Highest value; in-home appointment offer |
| Type and material | “vinyl replacement windows,” “bay window replacement,” “double hung windows installed” | Product-led pages; only for products the client sells |
| Brand | Brand name + “replacement windows” | Dealers only, and ad-text use needs authorization ([Trademarks](https://support.google.com/adspolicy/answer/6118)) |
| Repair | “foggy window repair,” “broken window glass replacement,” “window seal repair” | Smaller jobs; separate budget, or negative if the client doesn’t do repairs |
| Egress | “egress window installation” | Code-driven; pairs with [basement finishing](https://www.netembark.com/ppc/home-improvement/basement-finishing/) |
| Cost | “cost to replace windows in a house,” “replacement window cost per window” | Planning stage; cost page; asks for window count |

## Numbers Don’t Lie!

**$40M+**Google Ads spend managed

**18**years in business

**1,000+**happy customers

**1M+**conversions

**4.9★**Google rating

**Up to 6x**ROAS\*

*   Since 2009
*   Fortune 5000 Company
*   Top 1% of digital marketing agencies

[Book a call](https://cal.com/gary-pyatigorsky-netembark/30min)

\* Best result in an e-commerce Google Ads account; results vary by account. [See case studies](https://www.netembark.com/ppc/home-improvement/window-companies/#results)

Window companies

## How do you track leads through appointment set, held, and sold?

**Create separate conversion actions for each stage and upload them from the CRM with the sale value. Bid on held or sold appointments once there’s enough volume.**

*   Capture the GCLID on forms and use [call conversion tracking](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/6100664) for calls from ads and the site.
*   In the CRM, mark _appointment set_, _appointment held_ (demo run), and _sold_ (with contract value).
*   Upload those through [offline conversion import](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/2998031) or [enhanced conversions for leads](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/15713840). Google says uploads move to the Data Manager API starting June 15, 2026, so check any custom integration.
*   Set conversion windows to cover the sales cycle, [up to 90 days](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/3123169).
*   Use “appointment held” as the primary bidding conversion if sold volume is too thin, and “sold” with value once it isn’t.

*   **Netembark imports booked estimates and won jobs into Google Ads as offline conversions** ([offline conversion imports](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/2998031)), so bidding learns from real outcomes, not just leads.

[Book a call](https://cal.com/gary-pyatigorsky-netembark/30min)

![Google Ads reporting dashboard showing booked estimates](https://www.netembark.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/ppc-roi-reporting-1.webp)

Window companies

## What negative keywords does a window company need?

**Window campaigns pick up more off-topic searches than almost any other trade. Block software, cleaning, tint, appliances, and window coverings before launch.**

*   **Software:** microsoft, windows 10, windows 11, windows update, laptop, pc, activation, install windows
*   **Cleaning (separate trade):** window cleaning, window washing, window washer
*   **Auto:** window tint, car window, auto glass, windshield, power window repair
*   **Appliances and coverings:** window ac, window air conditioner,
